# 2026 New Grad Positions by Coder Quad and Simplify Use this repo to share and keep track of entry-level software, tech, CS, PM, quant jobs for 2025 & 2026 new graduates. The list is updated and maintained daily by Coder Quad and [Simplify](https://simplify.jobs/?utm_source=GHList&utm_medium=title)! 🙏 **Contribute by submitting an [issue](https://github.com/SimplifyJobs/New-Grad-Positions/issues/new/choose)! See the contribution guidelines [here](./CONTRIBUTING.md)!** 🙏 --- ### Browse 621 New Grad Roles by Category 💻 **[Software Engineering](#-software-engineering-new-grad-roles)** (339) 📱 **[Product Management](#-product-management-new-grad-roles)** (19) 🤖 **[Data Science, AI & Machine Learning](#-data-science-ai--machine-learning-new-grad-roles)** (106) 📈 **[Quantitative Finance](#-quantitative-finance-new-grad-roles)** (28) 🔧 **[Hardware Engineering](#-hardware-engineering-new-grad-roles)** (129) 💼 **[Other](#-other-new-grad-roles)** (0) ---

😫 Hate retyping your resume for every application?

Autofill all your applications in a single click

Stop manually re-entering your information. Simplify's extension helps you autofill job applications on millions of sites.

---

😮‍💨 Tired of checking every day for new roles?

A community member made ⬇️ SWEList ⬇️ that sends email alerts for new roles in this repo.

Share any other cool projects you make using the repo, and we might give you a shoutout!
